name: Slip Jim / SeaRAT
description: The Slip Jim is a thin, flexible tool used for rapid latch access on doors with exposed latch bolts. It can slip behind a latch bolt and retract it directly without any tension or picking. Effective on light commercial and residential latches where the bolt is not fully recessed into a strike plate, and particularly useful on interior doors within a facility once initial perimeter access has been achieved.

blue.det: Tool insertion visible; door open alert; camera footage of exterior approach.
blue.cm: Anti-shimming latch bolts; latch guards; door alarms; camera coverage; spring latch replacement with deadbolt.
